4 ارخّهُ He put much water into it [so as to make it soft]; namely, dough. (TA.) ＝
-A2- [The inf. n.] إِرْخَاخٌ also signifies The exceeding the usual, or ordinary, or the just, or proper, bounds, or degree; or the acting egregiously, or immoderately; or the like; (syn. مُبَالَغَةٌ;) in a thing. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
